description: Runtime Adapter Admission Rules - 后续Provider接入的唯一准入规则

admissionRules.name: new provider must use canonical runtime binding
admissionRules.description: 所有新Platform Provider必须通过RuntimeBinding声明运行时类型

admissionRules.name: new provider must not use legacy runtime adapter
admissionRules.note: B9P6已冻结Legacy Runtime Adapter迁移边界

admissionRules.name: new provider must not bypass permission
new provider must not bypass execution pipeline
admissionRules.description: 所有Tool执行必须经过ExecutionPipeline (包括PermissionGate/ScopeGate/AvailabilityGate等)

admissionRules.name: no raw secret in binding metadata
no second platform tool registry
admissionRules.description: Platform Provider不得拥有独立全局Tool Registry

admissionRules.name: no second permission center
admissionRules.description: Platform Provider不得拥有独立Permission Store / Broker
